text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone, thank you so much
for all your support today!
(Waaaaaaah...!)

With an even larger audience,
that day's Winning Live was filled with more heat and excitement than ever before—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Uhyaa... Hot, hot, hot!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: My whole body is still all warm and cozy~
choice_data_list: That really got everyone hyped, huh!
That really got everyone hyped, didn't it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Right? Truly...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it's okay to think
that Falco contributed at least a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm sure the next race will be even more exciting♪
choice_data_list: Then let's stand on the grandest stage of all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Which means...?
choice_data_list: How about running in the Tokyo Daishoten?
Why don't we run in the Tokyo Daishoten?

text_block_list.text:
The year-end Grand Prix race, the Arima Kinen.
Held immediately after, the final GⅠ race of the year is the Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!
It really feels like the end of the year!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "I feel like Falco used to see that on TV a lot too."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean broadcast TV?!
Falco's gonna be an Umadol on TV?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Then you absolutely have to enter!
Let's run in the Tokyo Daishoten!"
And so, the next target race was decided: the Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Finally, we're taking on the absolute pinnacle of dirt...
the top stage! ☆
On the way back—

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Um... you're Falco-chan,
the "Umadol," right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yep☆ It's Falco♪

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, amazing!
I only learned about you recently, but...

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
I heard about you from my fellow idol-otaku friends.
They said there's an 'Umadol' giving it her absolute all!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
I watched all the live concert footage on UmaTube!
It was so, so good!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You watched me? I'm so happy☆
Thank you♪

Smart Falcon's full-power live performances seem to charm
more than just racing fans.
As I felt her fandom growing—

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
"When is your next live concert?
I haven't seen you live in person yet, so I definitely want to go!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco's running the Tokyo Daishoten next!
You definitely have to come watch, okay?☆"

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: Tokyo... Daishoten?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the Tokyo Daishoten!
It's the very last race of the year☆

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, so the Arima Kinen isn't
the final race at the end of the year?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll look it up and go watch.
Do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-yep☆
Thank youuuu♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Um... hey.
This might be a weird question, but.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Dirt racing...
is really getting hyped up right now, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, it's really nothing major!
I was just a little curious, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...No, never mind after all!
Forget I said anything!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah!
Oh yeah, Falco had a favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, let's go watch the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's the top stage for turf racing that everyone knows and cares about!
I'm sure there's so much we can learn from it."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I want to use it as reference
for my performance at the Tokyo Daishoten!☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't it great?

Her overly cheerful demeanor weighs on my mind, but...
I agree that watching top-level races would be good study.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay☆
That's a promise, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer!
Good niiiiight☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Dream sweet dreams of Falco, okay?♪

And so, before our target race, the Tokyo Daishoten,
we decided to go watch the Arima Kinen.
